‘Honkai: Star Rail’ Version 4.6 “Dance With the Beast Before Moonrise” Launches 28 Sept.
items.summary: Over the weekend, publisher HoYoverse announced that Version 4.6 for their free-to-play turn-based role-playing game title 'Honkai: Star Rail' will launch
items.content:
Over the weekend, publisher HoYoverse announced that Version 4.6 for their free-to-play turn-based role-playing game title ‘Honkai: Star Rail’ will launch on 28 September across PC, PlayStation 5 consoles, and mobile devices. Dubbed “Dance With the Beast Before Moonrise”, players were made aware of Nihilux’s true identity as Aha, the Aeon of Elation. Now, alongside the Trailblazer and with Pearl’s assistance, they will head to the Life Sciences Institute deep within Astropolis to uncover the truth behind the scheme to “weaponize the husk”. Pearl and the limited 5-star Light Cone “Colors for Tomorrow” will both be boosted in the first half alongside Evanescia. Then, in the second half, the limited 5-star character Mortenax Blade will be getting a rerun.

Additionally, more details have been made available regarding the previously announced ‘Zenless Zone Zero’ collaboration, slated for the game’s Version 4.8 patch window. Ellen Joe and Astra will be making their debut by then, and Razer becomes the latest accessory maker to join in on the physical goods collab train. More details can be found below:

Serving as the source of all imagenae in Astropolis, the Life Sciences Institute was built under the leadership of Madam Yabuli, head of the IPC’s Technology Department. Now, Yabuli is pushing forward a dangerous plan to “weaponize the husk,” at the cost of every life in Planarcadia, and is even suspected of harboring ties with a mysterious faction that worships the Voracity in Astropolis. To protect the peace of Planarcadia, Pearl plans to use the recovery of Leviathan Essence as a cover to dispatch Kuchiba and Ashveil on a coordinated investigation deep into the Life Sciences Institute, teaming up with the Trailblazer and Nihilux to crush this conspiracy once and for all.

In this update, Pearl, a 5-star Ice character following the Path of Elation, will officially become a playable character. The CEO of Planarcadia has always been known for her raw computational power and rational decision-making. When the critical threat of the Voracity struck, she decisively arranged for Planarcadia’s residents to evacuate on the Astral Express, while she herself stayed behind to oversee the encanvasing ritual. In this story, Pearl and the Trailblazer will witness together how “Preservation” and “Art” ultimately merge into a single theme. Outside the story, Pearl’s understanding of art is equally reflected in combat.

During combat, Pearl can consume her “Certified Banger” (lol) to offset a portion of DMG for all ally characters. At the same time, Pearl can enter the “Deep Learning” state to learn the combat data of a designated teammate and gain a corresponding Enhanced ATK. If this teammate is an Elation character, Pearl’s Enhanced ATK will deal additional Elation DMG to enemies. If the entire team consists of Elation characters, this teammate will also gain an extra turn, while receiving a massive amount of Punchline and “Certified Banger.”

As for the version’s events, the brand-new “Love, Ghosts & Robots” event is coming soon. The Trailblazer will help the resurrected Skott run a mechatron workshop, assembling and selling mechatrons to gradually build the workshop into a project with a five-star rating. Meanwhile, the massive combat reality show event, “Interastral Peace Gala: One Take,” will also kick off. On top of that, the brand-new “Astral Imagea” gameplay will officially debut. Trailblazers can obtain multiple Astral Imageas to tag along on their adventures, and co-op with friends to take on the “Astral Slammers Squad!” challenge.

Furthermore, Hyacine’s new outfit “Warm Cotton Skies” and Evanescia’s new outfit “Lunar Blossoming” will hit the Outfit Show Window together. You absolutely don’t want to miss out!

Lastly, Honkai: Star Rail has officially announced a collaboration with Razer! The collaboration peripherals feature a Silver Wolf LV.999-themed gaming chair, keyboard, mouse, and headset, which will be released simultaneously across multiple regions worldwide. More details will be announced soon. Furthermore, the Honkai: Star Rail and Zenless Zone Zero collaboration characters have been officially unveiled: Ellen and Astra Yao from the world of Zenless Zone Zero will join the cosmic adventure in Version 4.8. Stay tuned!

Honkai: Star Rail is a free-to-play gacha title available on PC via HoYoPlay , PlayStation 5 consoles, and mobile devices ( iOS , Android via Google Play / Galaxy Store ), exceeding 150 million total downloads across all platforms since its launch back in 2023.

items.summary: Developer HoYoverse had been on hand during the latest Honkai: Star Rail special program to present Version 4.6: Dance with the Beast Before Moonrise. The update will be going online on September 28, 2026, with
items.content:
Developer HoYoverse had been on hand during the latest Honkai: Star Rail special program to present Version 4.6: Dance with the Beast Before Moonrise. The update will be going online on September 28, 2026, with the continuation of the latest main storyline and the new playable character, Pearl.

Players got a bit of a close-up of IPC’s inner business in Version 4.5 while trying to get support for Planarcadia’s plight. However, now it’s up to the Trailblazer to dive deep into Astropolis’ “Life Sciences Institute” to investigate the project driven by Yabuli to “weaponize the husk,” and put a stop to the conspiracy that threatens Planarcadia.

Despite the Trailblazer’s victory over the IPC in V4.5, the dangerous life proceeds onward, even if it means sacrificing every life on Planarcadia to a mysterious faction that worships the Voracity in Astropolis. Pearl plans to use the recovery of Leviathan essense as a cover to dispatch Kuchiba and Ashveil on a coordinated investigation where they would team up with Nihilux and Trailblazer to crush this conspiracy.

“The beast stirring in the darkness opens THEIR maw once more, demanding a god as a sacrifice. Before the moon rises again, only the blood of the wise can sate THEIR hunger…”

items.title: Honkai: Star Rail Zenless Zone Zero Crossover Starts in 4.8
items.summary: The 4.6 Honkai: Star Rail update is out this month and the Zenless Zone Zero Astra Yao and Ellen Joe crossover comes in 4.8.
items.content:
During the 4.6 Honkai: Star Rail Special Program we learned the Zenless Zone Zero crossover involving Astra Yao and Ellen Joe will happen in version 4.8. We know 4.6 will debut on September 28, 2026 as well and feature Pearl as one of the new units.

The Zenless Zone Zero Honkai: Star Rail teaser mainly served to show how how the two will look in the game and tease their attacks. We see Ellen using her weapon to deal what looks like Ice damage with her Sharknami. With Astra, it seems like a hint at her being able to enter the Idyllic Cadenza state. Since we expect 4.6 to run until about November 2026, we might not see 4.8 and this crossover until January 2027.

As for 4.6, we know more about it too. The Trailblaze Missions for Planarcadia will continue, with Pearl playing a part in the story. The five-star Ice Elation heroine will also be part of the first two banners for the update alongside an Evanescia rerun. Evanescia will also get a Lunar Blooming outfit. The second half of the update will feature the return of the Mortenax Blade alt. The Love, Ghosts & Robots and Interastral Peace Gala: One Take events will also be held.

You can see the full Special Program for 4.6 below.

Honkai: Star Rail is available for the PS5, PC, and mobile devices, with 4.6 arriving on September 28, 2026. Zenless Zone Zero is on the PS5, Xbox Series X, PC, and mobile devices. The Honkai: Star Rail crossover that adds the Zenless Zone Zero characters Astra Yao and Ellen Joe will appear in 4.8.

items.title: Ellen Joe, Astra Yao to arrive in Honkai Star Rail Version 4.8 as part of Zenless Zone Zero collab
items.summary: The Honkai: Star Rail and Zenless Zone Zero collaboration will mark the first-ever direct crossover event for HoYoverse games.
items.content:
All News Ellen Joe and Astra Yao are coming to HSR as part of its collab with ZZZ (Image: HoYoverse).

{" "} Ellen Joe, Astra Yao to arrive in Honkai Star Rail Version 4.8 as part of Zenless Zone Zero collab .iframe-media {width: 100%;aspect-ratio: auto 16/9;} .img-media {width: 100%;aspect-ratio: auto 16/9;} .a-img-media {aspect-ratio: auto 16/9;} The Honkai: Star Rail and Zenless Zone Zero collaboration will mark the first-ever direct crossover event for HoYoverse games. HoYoverse has revealed that Ellen Joe and Astra Yao will be added in Honkai: Star Rail Version 4.8 as part of its highly-anticipated collaboration event with Zenless Zone Zero. HoYoverse made the reveal during the Honkai: Star Rail Version 4.7 preview livestream on Sunday (20 September).

HoYoverse first announced the Honkai: Star Rail-Zenless Zone Zero collaboration in August, marking the first-ever direct collaboration between two of HoYoverse's biggest modern games. Honkai: Star Rail Version 4.8 is expected to be released in late December.

While HoYoverse did not release any more details on the upcoming Honkai: Star Rail-Zenless Zone Zero collab, we can expect Ellen Joe and Astra Yao will fulfill roles as Honkai: Star Rail characters similar to that of their original versions in Zenless Zone Zero.

In Zenless Zone Zero, Ellen Joe is a S-Rank Ice Attack agent. Ellen Joe's kit is centered around gaining Flash Freeze Charge through her skills and attacks. When she has enough Flash Freeze Charge, Ellen Joe's attacks and skills are empowered to deal additional Ice DMG and inflict the Freeze status on enemies.

We can expect Ellen Joe to still utilise the Ice element as a Honkai: Star Rail character. Her kit being geared towards dealing damage and freezing enemies also likely mean she will follow the Path of Nihility.

Meanwhile, Astra Yao is a S-Rank Ether Support agent in Zenless Zone Zero. Astra Yao's kit lets her increase the ATK and Crit DMG of her teammates after entering the Idyllic Cadenza state. She also deals a considerable amount of damage on her own and as an assist ability when other squad members attack.

We can expect Astra Yao to fulfill a similar support role in Honkai: Star Rail as a character following the Path of Harmony. While there is no direct equivalent to the Ether element in Honkai: Star Rail, the Quantum element is the most similar among those in the game.

The collaboration will not only see Zenless Zone Zero characters coming to Honkai: Star Rail, but the other way around as well. HoYoverse is set to officially announce the Honkai: Star Rail character being added to Zenless Zone Zero as part of the collab in the latter's next version preview livestream.

items.title: Why Honkai: Star Rail players talk quitting the game
items.summary: Honkai: Star Rail players and creators are debating whether to quit amid complaints about power creep, endgame design, events and story presentation.
items.content:
A wave of Reddit posts and YouTube videos about quitting Hoyoverse ‘s Honkai: Star Rail has put long-running complaints over power creep, endgame design and story presentation back at the centre of the game’s community debate.

The discussion does not establish that Star Rail is facing a measurable player exodus. The sources reviewed offer no player-count data. What they do show is a recurring concern from active and former players: the game can demand continued investment while giving some of them fewer reasons to log in.

YouTuber Pixel Tree , who said he had not played Star Rail for some time, argued that the current criticism was more notable because it was coming from the game’s own community rather than rival fandoms. He said seeing regular Star Rail creators express frustration suggested there was a genuine issue behind the wider social media debate.

Power creep is one of the complaints that appears most consistently across the Reddit post and creator videos. Players argue that the gap between older and newer characters has grown enough to change how they approach pulling, building and spending on units.

Read more: Hoyoverse announces Genshin Impact 7.1 Special Program date

GachaNekoVT , who said he still plays Star Rail, argued that the problem goes beyond new characters simply being stronger. Players may begin wondering how long a newly acquired character will remain useful before another unit performs the same role more effectively.

That can also make spending harder to justify. Building a character can take weeks or months, while obtaining higher Eidolons or signature Light Cones can require further investment. The concern is that the value of that investment may decline much faster than players expect.

Similar complaints in the material point to newer characters replacing older ones with comparable but stronger kits, widening the perceived gap between generations of units.

Endgame design has intensified that frustration. Players criticised rising enemy health and mechanics that favour particular character archetypes or team compositions. The Reddit author described the meta as increasingly punishing for players who want to continue using older characters.

Read more: Genshin Impact 7.0: Are Flins and Ineffa worth pulling?

Kekvin agreed that recent bosses and endgame modes can restrict viable teams, although he noted that power creep itself is hardly new to Star Rail. His criticism focused more on how newer encounters can turn difficulty into a question of which characters a player owns rather than how they use them.

The Reddit post from DependentNo1079 described Planarcadia as a story that was not necessarily bad but had failed to meet expectations. Its author pointed to repetitive animations, lengthy dialogue and presentation that can struggle to make major story moments feel distinct.

Pixel Tree discussed similar complaints, including repeated character poses, reused models and limited animation. The material also highlights the game’s frequent reliance on text screens during story sequences, an approach that has become a recurring joke within the community.

GachaNekoVT raised a different problem with the writing itself. He praised Star Rail’s characters and music but argued that recent stories can become difficult to follow because of the volume of lore, terminology and exposition.
